info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Merchant  Participation API
Provides status of merchant participation updates

params.name: request_id
params.description: The request ID is obtained by calling POST /merchants/participations API.

params.name: offset
params.description: Determines the number of items needed in the start of the list, to retrieve the list starting from the offset.

params.name: limit
params.description: Controls the maximum number of items in the list.

items.docs:
Allows registered partners to fetch a list of merchants with participation details whose participation request is completed successfully. If query parameter 'request_id' is supplied then the response will be limited to only those merchant objects with any status (PENDING, COMPLETED) that were part of that particular request.

For details on mandatory fields in response, please consult the description section of the POST: /merchants/participations endpoint.

info.name: Allows a registered partner to create or update merchant participation details

items.docs:
This endpoint enables registered partners to manage merchant participation details, indicating whether a merchant has opted into or out of Buy Now Pay Later. A unique MAID-based merchant is identified by a combination of acquirerICA, merchantLegalName, and countryCode.
